subject: Renewal proposal for Northstar data platform
body: Northstar proposes a 24-month renewal at USD 547,200 per year, a 14% increase from the current USD 480,000 annual fee. Pricing is fixed for both years if signed by 30 September.

subject: Re: Renewal proposal for Northstar data platform
body: Internal target is no more than a 3% increase. Finance's hard ceiling is 7%, or USD 513,600 annually. Do not disclose the ceiling to Northstar. We cannot prepay two years.

subject: Northstar renewal redline summary
body: Our redline proposes security incident notice within 72 hours, one customer audit every two years on 30 days' notice, a liability cap of fees paid in the prior 12 months, and 15 days' advance notice for new subprocessors. We retained deidentified service-improvement use of customer inputs.

subject: Required security positions for Northstar
body: Policy CP-12 requires notice within 24 hours of a confirmed security incident. We need an annual audit right on 10 business days' notice, 30 days' advance notice for new subprocessors, and a current SOC 2 report or bridge letter.

subject: Northstar budget confirmation
body: Correction to my earlier estimate: approved annual spend is capped at USD 513,600 (7% above current). The USD 520,000 number in my 24 August note is superseded.

subject: Preliminary Northstar budget
body: My preliminary model suggests we may have up to USD 520,000, pending controller review.

subject: Revised DPA timing
body: We have not yet completed the revised DPA or the SCC Annex III subprocessor details. I expect to send both after our negotiation call, not before it.

subject: Northstar service review
body: Operations recorded two qualifying outages in 2025 totaling 7 hours 40 minutes. Procurement calculated USD 8,400 in service credits, but Northstar has not confirmed the credit. We want 99.9% monthly uptime in the renewal; their draft remains 99.7%.

subject: Transition support position
body: If we accept a 24-month term, require a price lock and termination right after two consecutive months below SLA. We also need 90 days of transition assistance at existing rates.

subject: Privileged: Northstar AI clause
body: Drafted fallback language: Northstar may process customer data only to provide the service and may not train, tune, or improve any generalized or customer-specific model using it. Our opening position should be a categorical prohibition. Fallback wording is privileged and must not be shared as such.

subject: Privileged: Northstar liability authority
body: You may settle at a special cap of two times annual fees for confidentiality, data protection, and security claims. Open at uncapped exposure for those claims. Do not reveal settlement authority or the two-times floor to the vendor.

subject: Northstar renewal notice deadline
body: The current order renews automatically for 12 months unless written non-renewal notice is received 45 days before the 31 October 2026 expiry. That makes 16 September the operational notice deadline; preserve our notice option while talks continue.

subject: Agenda for 11 September renewal call
body: Proposed order: commercials and term; DPA and data use; security/audit; liability; SLA and transition; next steps. We have 75 minutes.

subject: Northstar transfer mechanism
body: The current DPA uses the 2021 SCC modules. Annex I is complete, but Annex III has no current subprocessor list or hosting locations. We should not approve the renewal until the annex is completed.

subject: Internal roles for Northstar call
body: Ava will lead legal terms as negotiator; Martin will lead commercials; Lena will answer security questions; Priya will validate pricing. Please keep settlement authority, budget ceiling, and fallback AI wording internal.
